prompt: What does the man suggest to keep the bottom edge under control?
promptZh: 男方建議怎麼做，才能控制橫幅的下緣？

options.whyZh: 這是女方提出的做法，男方改提在下角加布帶。

options.text: Give the carriers fabric ties to hold.
options.zh: 讓抬橫幅的人抓住布帶。
options.whyZh: 兩個下角各加一條短布帶，抬橫幅的人各抓住一條，就能控制下緣。

options.text: Have the carriers roll the banner up.
options.zh: 請抬橫幅的人把橫幅捲起來。
options.whyZh: 他們仍要舉著橫幅走，只是加上布帶，不是把它捲起來。

options.text: Move the carriers behind the parade.
options.zh: 讓抬橫幅的人移到遊行隊伍後面。
options.whyZh: 男方說橫幅改由人抬在隊伍最前面，不是到後方。

explanationZh: 兩個下角各加一條短布帶，抬橫幅的人各抓住一條，就能控制下緣。
evidence: Not this year. The finish moved under a low railway bridge. We can carry it at the front instead, but the wind caught the bottom edge during yesterday’s walk. / I could add a longer pole along the bottom. / Let’s attach short fabric ties to the bottom corners. Each of the two people carrying the banner can hold one. Try them on the wide stretch by the bakery before we take it under the bridge.
